# Pull Request: Summary of Changes

## 📝 Summary
Provide a brief description of the changes in this PR. What problem does it solve or what feature does it add?

---

## 🔗 Related Issue
Link the Issue this PR addresses:

`Fixes #<issue-number>`  
or  
`Closes #<issue-number>`

---

## 🧪 What Was Done
Describe the main changes. Examples include:

- Added new function(s)
- Updated pipeline components
- Modified documentation
- Added or changed data‑handling logic
- Fixed a bug

---

## 🧬 How to Test
Explain how a reviewer can test or verify your changes. Include:

- Functions to run
- Expected outputs
- Any required data
- Steps in the pipeline (if applicable)

If no testing is needed, state that clearly.

---

## 📚 Documentation
Check all that apply:

- [ ] Added or updated function documentation (roxygen2)
- [ ] Updated README
- [ ] Updated Wiki
- [ ] Added comments or inline explanations
- [ ] Not applicable

---

## 🧹 Code Quality
Before submitting, confirm:

- [ ] Code runs without errors
- [ ] No raw data was committed
- [ ] No large files were added unintentionally
- [ ] Branch is up to date with `main`

---

## 👀 Reviewer Notes
Anything the reviewer should pay special attention to?

- Assumptions made
- Design decisions
- Questions
- Known limitations

---

## 🌿 Additional Context
Add any extra information that might help reviewers understand the PR.
